## How to list subdomains of `paypal.com` with a continuation cursor

### 1. Build the request URL

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains
```

### 2. Add query parameters

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `limit`   | `25`  | Return up to 25 results per page |
| `cursor`  | `pp_next` | Use the cursor returned from the previous page (if any) |

So the full URL becomes:

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next
```

### 3. Set the HTTP headers

```http
GET /api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next HTTP/1.1
Host: www.virustotal.com
Accept: application/json
x-apikey: pp_key123
```

> **Important**: Never share your API key publicly. In production code, store it securely (e.g., environment variable, secrets manager).

### 4. Example using `curl`

```bash
curl -X GET \
  "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next" \
  -H "x-apikey: pp_key123" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
```

### 5. Example using Python (`requests`)

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains"
params = {"limit": 25, "cursor": "pp_next"}
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "pp_key123",
    "Accept": "application/json",
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
data = response.json()
print(data)
```

### 6. Handling pagination

The response will include a `links` object with a `next` field containing the next cursor value. Use that cursor in the next request to fetch subsequent pages.

```json
{
  "data": [...],
  "links": {
    "next": "next_cursor_value",
    ...
  }
}
```

Repeat the request with `cursor=next_cursor_value` until no `next` link is present.

---

### What you’ll see

The JSON response will contain an array of subdomain objects, each with fields like:

- `id` – the subdomain name
- `type` – `"subdomain"`
- `attributes` – metadata (e.g., first seen, last seen, etc.)

Example snippet:

```json

  "data": [
    {
      "id": "api.paypal.com",
      "type": "subdomain",
      "attributes": { ... }
    },
    {
      "id": "sandbox.paypal.com",
      "type": "subdomain",
      "attributes": { ... }
    },
    ...
  ],
  "links": { ... }
}
```
